title: Anthropic Shares Slip as AI and Tech Stock Sell-Off Continues
partialText: The S&P 500 ended the day down more than 10 percent from its recent high, in a symbolic measure of investors’ souring mood.

title: What Is a Stock Market Correction?
partialText: The S&P 500 has fallen more than 10 percent from its recent high, crossing a threshold that signals investors have turned pessimistic about stocks.

title: Alice Huang, Accused of Spying on Nvidia’s CEO, Is Linked to Firms With Ties to China’s Military
partialText: Companies linked to Alice Huang, the woman at the heart of the Nvidia scandal, are part of a network of Chinese tech firms and defense contractors that need advanced computing power.

title: How Jensen Huang Made Humiliation Routine at Nvidia
partialText: The Nvidia co-founder’s belittling behavior toward employees goes back decades. It once led to a confidential settlement agreement with an executive who said Mr. Huang “terrorized” staff.

title: How We Broke Open the Nvidia Investigation
partialText: A global reporting effort by The New York Times included many twists and turns, from surprising photos and shipment records to a big break through astonishing tips from sources.

title: Fact-Checking Trump’s News Conference After His Asia Trip
partialText: President Trump repeated and revised a number of falsehoods and exaggerations during a news conference.

title: C.F.T.C. Officials Considered Investigating Trump’s Memecoin, Then Punted
partialText: Lawyers at the Commodity Futures Trading Commission looked into possible fraud soon after the digital token’s launch, then decided they would not get the commission’s support.

title: Playing ‘Key of Life,’ Stevie Wonder Invites All to Match His Joy
partialText: Wonder’s optimism was refracted around Madison Square Garden as he performed his “Songs in the Key of Life” album on a 50th anniversary tour.

title: Democrats Strengthen the Legal Line With Attorneys General Triumphs
partialText: Once considered vulnerable to local issues, Democratic candidates for attorneys general romped on Tuesday, with the final contests called against Republican attorneys general in Kansas and Ohio.

title: As He Leaves Office, Ken Paxton Drops Suits Against Political Opponents
partialText: The Texas attorney general has abandoned suits against Muslim and immigrant rights groups — and the N.C.A.A.

title: A Supermodel Will Finally Get Her Day in Court
partialText: Carré Otis spent years trying to serve her former agent in a lawsuit accusing him of sexual abuse. It took an international operation to make it happen.

title: Britain and Brussels Have Begun a Brexit Rollback. How Far Will It Go?
partialText: The United Kingdom is removing barriers with the European Union a decade after it voted to leave. Global turmoil, and the disruptive policies of President Trump, helped push them back together.

title: Anthropic Mathematician Claims to Have Solved Math’s Most Famous Problem
partialText: If confirmed, the proof of the Riemann hypothesis would cement the field’s sense that no unsolved problem is safe from artificial intelligence.

title: Jonathan Yardley, Who Reviewed 3,000 Books and Pulled Zero Punches, Has Died
partialText: As a Pulitzer Prize-winning critic for The Washington Post, he believed praise could be boring. He was 87.

title: What Are King Tides, and Why Is Everyone Talking About Them?
partialText: Because of El Niño, the Pacific Ocean is already higher than normal. This year, that could lead to some especially high tides.

title: As a Storm Floods Florida, Heavy Rain Will Creep Up the East Coast
partialText: A potential tropical storm off the coast of Florida is expected to move up the coast and could snarl Thanksgiving week travel.

title: John Grisham: Scott Colom Makes Me Proud of Mississippi
partialText: As a kid, I once watched the Ku Klux Klan burn a cross in my hometown in Mississippi. Sixty years later, I look forward to shaking Mr. Colom’s hand and telling him I’m proud he’s my senator.

title: How Do You Investigate a President This Corrupt?
partialText: The incoming House Oversight Committee chairman, Robert Garcia, lays out his committee’s top targets.

title: Grand Theft Auto VI Made $3.79 Billion in a Single Day
partialText: Anticipation was high after a 13-year gap in the game franchise. No movie has ever made more than $3 billion at the box office.
